citations.claim: approach S (index 2) waited 201s at red with 183 queued at first violating step, EW still green

counterfactual.change: set actuated true->false (fixed-time); same steps/events, failure disappears because fixed cycle does not rely on detectors

explanation: Actuated control with detector_fail on W holds EW green continuously from before t=1459 through step 1585 (>126s, exceeding max_green_seconds=77) while NS approaches wait at red (N wait 69->130->195, S wait 75->136->201). The controller fails to terminate/max-recall the failed-detector direction, so NS starves past the 200s max_wait limit.

violation.detail: approach 2 has waited 201 s at red with vehicles queued (limit 200)

vision_note: Queued north-south vehicles remain stopped at the intersection across steps 1582 to 1585 with no discharge or change in positions. One direction appears to hold the right-of-way while the waiting approaches starve and never advance.
